name: Electric Furnace
description: The Electric Furnace is a basic machine that uses electricity to smelt items. It is faster and more energy efficient than a traditional coal furnace. Can be upgraded with overclocker upgrades for increased speed.

name: Macerator
description: The Macerator grinds ores and other materials into dust, doubling your ore output. Essential for efficient resource processing in the early game.

name: Compressor
description: The Compressor compresses items into more compact forms. Used to create advanced alloys, compressed plates, and various industrial materials.

name: Extractor
description: The Extractor extracts valuable substances from raw materials. Essential for obtaining rubber from resin and various chemical extractions.

name: Industrial Centrifuge
description: The Industrial Centrifuge separates materials into their component parts using high-speed rotation. Required for processing complex ores and creating advanced materials.

name: Electrolyzer
description: The Electrolyzer uses electricity to break down compounds into their elemental components. Key machine for chemical processing chains.

name: Assembler
description: The Assembler combines multiple components into complex items. Automates crafting of circuits, machine parts, and other advanced components.

name: Chemical Reactor
description: The Chemical Reactor combines chemical compounds to create new substances. Essential for producing advanced materials, fuels, and chemical products.

name: Bronze Void Miner
description: The Bronze Void Miner extracts resources directly from the void. A powerful multiblock structure for passive resource generation.
